title: Discussion on Elastic Search Implementation with Ankit and Hongye Qian
summary_brief: In this technical discussion, Ankit and Hongye Qian explore the implementation of Elastic Search, focusing on the differences between dense and sparse factors, and the importance of filters for improving search efficiency. They also discuss the challenges faced during testing and the need for further refinement in their approach.

actions.description_plain: Hongye will conduct tests on Elastic Search using filters to improve the accuracy of search results.
Ankit will gather real conversation transcripts to include in the testing data for better model training.
